datasets.name: product_scatter
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.price,
  pp.total_units_sold,
  pp.total_revenue,
  pp.total_profit
FROM
  customer_360.gold.dim_product p
    JOIN customer_360.gold.product_performance pp
      ON p.product_id = pp.product_id

datasets.name: daily_sales_with_date
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.sales_date,
  s.total_orders,
  s.total_revenue,
  s.avg_order_value,
  s.total_items_sold,
  s.unique_customers,
  s.delivered_orders,
  s.cancelled_orders,
  s.returned_orders,
  d.year,
  d.quarter,
  d.month,
  d.month_name,
  d.day_of_week,
  d.day_name,
  d.week_of_year,
  d.is_weekend
FROM
  customer_360.gold.daily_sales s
    JOIN customer_360.gold.dim_date d
      ON s.sales_date = d.date

datasets.name: top_customers_spend
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_name,
  total_spend
FROM
  customer_360.gold.customer_summary
ORDER BY
  total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_products_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  product_name,
  total_revenue
FROM
  customer_360.gold.product_performance
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_products_profit
queryLines:
SELECT
  product_name,
  total_profit
FROM
  customer_360.gold.product_performance
ORDER BY
  total_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_subcat_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  sub_category,
  SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM
  customer_360.gold.product_performance
GROUP BY
  sub_category
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ticket_heatmap
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(ticket_created_at, 'EEEE') AS day_name,
  DAYOFWEEK(ticket_created_at) AS dow_num,
  priority,
  issue_category,
  ticket_id,
  resolution_hours,
  is_resolved,
  sla_met
FROM
  customer_360.gold.fact_support
